public_body: Cotuit Board Of Fire Commissioners Union Negotiation Committee
overall: The Attorney General found that the subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding an unnoticed closed-door deliberation with a quorum on March 9, 2016, and ordered immediate and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that a quorum of the three-member union negotiation subcommittee deliberated on March 9, 2016 at the Fire Station outside a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: That the March 9, 2016 discussion took place in an unnoticed closed session violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The subcommittee's response disclosed an unnoticed March 7, 2016 discussion with counsel and the fire chief; it was not part of the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we note that the discussion that took place on March 7, 2016 also meetings the Open Meeting Law's definition of deliberation, and we remind the Subcommittee of its obligations under the law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
